extension.description: Shows the workspace's agent plans and opens Claude Code to run them.
extension.untrustedWorkspaces: The extension reads the plans without running workspace code, but it runs the Claude Code binary from the workspace folders; trust the workspace to see the panel.
setting.refreshIntervalMinutes: Minutes between automatic panel refreshes. 0 turns it off.
setting.notifications.taskStarted: Show a temporary notice when a task starts (moves to in-progress). Needs the panel open: with it hidden, notices come when it reappears.
setting.notifications.taskCompleted: Show a temporary notice when a task finishes (moves to done). Needs the panel open.
setting.notifications.runOpened: Show a temporary notice when a pilot run opens (a run log appears). Off by default. Needs the panel open.
setting.notifications.runClosed: Show a temporary notice when a pilot run closes (the run log gets its Closing section). Needs the panel open.
setting.notifications.handoff: Show a notice that stays until you close it when the pilot run passes the baton (a Handoff section appears in the run log), with a button to continue the run. Needs the panel open.
setting.notifications.taskWaitingOnOwner: Show a notice that stays until you close it when an in-progress task stops and waits for you (its Next step starts with Waiting on owner:), with a button to open the task. Needs the panel open.
setting.notifications.taskCancelled: Show a temporary notice when a task is cancelled (moves to cancelled), with the task that replaces it when there is one. Needs the panel open.
setting.notifications.taskAbandoned: Show a temporary notice when you give up a task (moves to abandoned): one notice per give-up, saying how many dependent tasks fell with it. Reopening does not notify. Needs the panel open.
setting.notifications.durationSeconds: Seconds a self-dismissing notice stays on screen (minimum 2).
setting.notifications.sound: Play a sound with notices, through the system's player (afplay on macOS, paplay or canberra-gtk-play on Linux, PowerShell on Windows). Only notices whose own setting is on make a sound.
setting.notifications.sound.attention: Sound only on the notices that need you: the run's handoff and a task waiting on you.
setting.notifications.sound.all: Sound on every notice, including the temporary ones.
setting.claudePath: Path to the Claude Code binary. Empty uses the official extension's or the one on the PATH.
setting.marketplace: Where to install the plan-relay plugin from: a clone's folder, a GitHub owner/repo or a git URL. Empty uses the workspace folder when it has the plan-relay marketplace, otherwise the plan-relay marketplace Claude Code already knows, otherwise the public repository over git.
